title: Design: the amber note on a work order and on a Part Sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts', 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Change Customer.
  4. Pick customer B.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Open Part Sale 1.
  7. Open Part Sale 1's three-dot menu.
  8. Click Change Customer.
  9. Pick customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Change Customer.

Step 3:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • An amber box with an orange warning icon appears under the pickers with the note, and Update Customer turns blue.
  • The note's colours and place match picture 14.4.

Step 5:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 6:

  • Part Sale 1 opens.

Step 7:

  • The menu lists Change Customer, Split Part Sale and Back to Part Sales.

Step 8:

  • The dialog opens with the Part Sale wording.

Step 9:

  • The amber note reads "This Part Sale keeps Default pricing." with tier A's name "applies to new Part Sales, or split this one to use it.", as in picture 14.5.
